title: Trent Dilfer gets first win in second stint as head coach of Lipscomb Academy (Tenn.)

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Trent Dilfer gets first win in second stint as head coach of Lipscomb Academy (Tenn.)
sources.description: After opening its 2026 season with a tough loss, Lipscomb Academy (Tenn.) got back on the horse and picked up a nice 16-6 road victory over Ravenwood on Friday night. It’s the first win of the year for returning Mustangs head coach Trent Dilfer. The former Super Bowl-winning quarterback opted to return to the high […]
